Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.teavm.c

Class PngCanvas

java.lang.Object
net.sourceforge.plantuml.teavm.c.PngCanvas
All Implemented Interfaces:
RasterCanvas
public final class PngCanvas extends Object implements RasterCanvas
The RasterCanvas of the TeaVM C build: drawn by plutovg (see NativeCanvas), text with the fonts embedded in the executable (Liberation Sans, whatever the family: the other families are not embedded yet), never the fonts of the machine. The PNG is encoded in C, as PngIO does on the JVM (src/teavm-c/native/plantuml_png.h). A canvas holds native memory: dispose() releases it.

    • drawImage

      public void drawImage(int[] argb, int width, int height, double x, double y, double scale)
      Description copied from interface: RasterCanvas
      Draws an image, given as 0xAARRGGBB pixels (not premultiplied) row by row, with its top left corner at (x, y), each of its pixels being scale units wide (1 copies the pixels when (x, y) is on the device grid). The color and the paint of the canvas are unchanged. As Graphics2D.drawImage(): the clip applies, the alpha channel is blended.
      Specified by:
      drawImage in interface RasterCanvas
